title: Research
text:
I am interested in applying GIS tools and techniques to historical questions. Projects that I have worked on include:

Roman villa site location analysis and predictive modeling
A Python implementation of Geomorphons
Application of low-cost drones to disaster efforts
Python-based DEM-based spatial statistics via WCS data-acquisition

Current projects include:

Spatial analysis of Dacian coin hoards to model deposition patterns during the Dacian Kingdom under Burebista
Synthetic voter data generation using Latent Class Analysis and Bayesian Networks to model demographic and media structure from voter polling data
ML classification of individual-rat attribution of ultrasonic vocalizations in multi-animal recordings

title: Teaching
text:
EPPS/GISC 3342 & GISC6379 Artificial Intelligence for Environmental Social Science
Fall 2026
Environmental Social Science (ESS) aims to understand the interplays of environmental and social factors and how the interplays shape communities. The course will overview AI-based computational approaches to analyze the environmental context in which social activities and processes evolve and to model the human-environment interactions for future projections.

Coin Hoard Data Generating Process
The data-generating process for coin hoards is inherently selective: hoards enter the archaeological record when people deliberately conceal coins and subsequently fail to recover them, while the observed dataset is further shaped by differential preservation, discovery, reporting, and publication.
